item.text:
**Verdict**
Mostly yes, with caveats. The 2024 record shows disciplined budgeting, continued RBI credibility, and outside confidence in India’s macro path, but the first post-election budget also bent toward coalition/voter management, and inflation/debt pressures were still active.

**Accepted Claims**
- [India budget shifts spending priorities while keeping fiscal deficit in check](https://theprint.in/india/india-budget-shifts-spending-priorities-while-keeping-fiscal-deficit-in-check/2187377/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 23 Jul 2024 | The budget cut the fiscal-deficit target to 4.9% of GDP while raising jobs/rural spending and changing taxes in ways meant to support investment. This is strong evidence for fiscal responsibility with a growth-and-investment tilt. IDs: `5B.3`, also `5B.1`.

- [Governor’s Statement: August 8, 2024](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=58448) | Reserve Bank of India | 8 Aug 2024 | RBI said its inflation framework had worked, inflation was on a declining path, and it kept the repo rate at 6.5% while staying focused on bringing inflation to target without sacrificing growth. This is strong evidence for monetary credibility and macro-stability discipline. IDs: `5B.3`.

- [Moody’s raises India’s growth forecasts, Fitch affirms rating](https://theprint.in/economy/moodys-raises-indias-growth-forecasts-fitch-affirms-rating/2243897/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 29 Aug 2024 | Moody’s raised growth forecasts and Fitch affirmed India’s sovereign rating, citing strong broad-based growth, easing inflation expectations, and policy continuity around infrastructure and ease of doing business. This supports a positive reading on investment conditions and macro stability. IDs: `5B.3`, also `5B.1`.

- [India eyes $100 billion annual foreign direct investment in coming years - IT minister](https://theprint.in/india/india-eyes-100-billion-annual-foreign-direct-investment-in-coming-years-it-minister/1928045/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 17 Jan 2024 | The government publicly framed 2024 around attracting large-scale FDI through infrastructure, manufacturing, and easier business processes. This is evidence of intent to improve long-run investment conditions. IDs: `5B.3`, also `5B.1`.

- [India’s Modi spends billions on jobs, key allies in first budget after election](https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-spends-billions-on-jobs-key-allies-in-first-budget-after-election/2187546/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 23 Jul 2024 | The first post-election budget directed large sums to jobs, rural programs, and coalition-partner states to win back voters and retain political support. This is counterevidence that fiscal choices were not purely macro-stability driven. IDs: `5B.3`, also `5B.1`.

- [India needs aggressive reduction in government debt, Moody’s analyst says](https://theprint.in/india/india-needs-aggressive-reduction-in-government-debt-moodys-analyst-says/2187309/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 23 Jul 2024 | Moody’s said India’s fiscal-deficit target was reasonable, but warned that faster debt reduction would improve the sovereign profile. This is mild counterevidence: fiscal policy was acceptable, but debt remained a structural risk. IDs: `5B.3`.

- [India’s September inflation likely overshot RBI’s 4% target: Reuters poll](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indias-september-inflation-likely-overshot-rbis-4-target-reuters-poll-3656769) | Reuters via Investing.com | 10 Sep 2024 | Reuters polling suggested inflation had moved back above the RBI’s target because of food-price pressure. This is counterevidence that price stability was fully secured in 2024. IDs: `5B.3`.

**Search gap**
- I did not find strong evidence of an outright RBI-independence breach in 2024; the available record points more to persistent inflation pressure than to political capture of monetary policy.
- I also did not find a clean, direct indicator of private investment response inside the year itself beyond rating-agency commentary and FDI-policy intent.
